title: fix: 8k preview never allocates a cpu frame

commit.merge_subject: merge: fix: 8k preview never allocates a cpu frame

description: An 8K-class preview frame that cannot take the GPU door (a LUT, nodes, a rotated source) fell to the CPU oracle, which allocates the whole frame as ARGB: 132 MB, OutOfMemoryError on the 256 MB heap, 12 of them in a 13 s playback and no frame shown (device, 8K clip with a LUT). It is now refused up front with the OutOfMemoryError the screens already turn into their short preview-too-large message. Export (maxDim < 0) is untouched. Build and JVM green; device verification pending (phone was in landscape).
changed: fix: 8k preview never allocates a cpu frame
